clues.it: Anna era nella 3ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e accanto a un barile o a una sedia.
clues.en: Anna was in the 3rd column, in the 1st row and beside a barrel or a chair.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 7ª colonna e sul Molo, ma non era accanto a uno scaffale.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 7th column and on the Dock, but was not beside a shelf.

clues.it: Luca era nella 3ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Rosa.
clues.en: Luca was in the 3rd row and in the same room as Rosa.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 5ª riga e in Cambusa, ma non era accanto a una rete.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 5th row and in the Galley, but was not beside a net.

clues.it: Olga era in una stanza diversa da Fabio e da sola in Plancia.
clues.en: Olga was in a different room from Fabio and alone on the Bridge.

clues.it: Irene era a ovest di Bruno e in Cambusa.
clues.en: Irene was west of Bruno and in the Galley.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 8ª colonna e accanto a una cuccetta, ma non era accanto a un'ancora.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 8th column and beside a bunk, but was not beside an anchor.

clues.it: Dario era nella 4ª colonna e nella 9ª riga, ma non era accanto a una lanterna.
clues.en: Dario was in the 4th column and in the 9th row, but was not beside a lantern.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 10ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Dario.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 10th column and in the same room as Dario.

clues.it: Marta era nella 11ª riga e a ovest di Luca.
clues.en: Marta was in the 11th row and west of Luca.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 1ª colonna e a ovest di Marta.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 1st column and west of Marta.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Anna lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Anna's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 7th.

steps.it: Solo Luca può stare nella 3ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 12ª è sua.
steps.en: Luca is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 12th is theirs.

steps.it: Solo Nino può stare nella 4ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 2ª è sua.
steps.en: Nino is the only one who can be in the 4th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 2nd is theirs.

steps.en: Bruno is the only one who can be in the 5th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 9th is theirs.

steps.en: Olga is the only one who can be in the 6th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 5th is theirs.

steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 8th, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 4th.

steps.en: Paolo is the only one who can be in the 10th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 10th is theirs.

steps.it: Solo Marta può stare nella 11ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 11ª è sua.
steps.en: Marta is the only one who can be in the 11th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 11th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 12ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Fabio's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 12th, column 1st.
